attempts.summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as a persistent, confined background service. It runs as the dedicated nologin system account inventorysvc inside a root-owned chroot, with /var/lib/inventory as its only writable directory. RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were preserved. The service recovered successfully after the mandatory node restart.
